Create Trigger CDN.TwrDostKod_InsertUpdateHandler on CDN.TwrDost For Insert,Update As If Update(TwD_KodOrgKnt) Begin Declare @KodOrgKnt varchar(40) Declare @TwrTyp smallint Declare @TwrFirma int Declare @TwrNumer int Declare @TwrLp smallint Declare @KntTyp smallint Declare @KntFirma int Declare @KntNumer int Declare @KntLp smallint
Declare cur_insertkod Cursor For Select Twd_KodOrgKnt, Twd_TwrTyp, Twd_TwrFirma, Twd_TwrNumer, Twd_TwrLp, Twd_KntTyp, Twd_KntFirma, Twd_KntNumer, Twd_KntLp From inserted
Open cur_InsertKod Fetch Next From cur_InsertKod Into @KodOrgKnt, @TwrTyp, @TwrFirma, @TwrNumer, @TwrLp, @KntTyp, @KntFirma, @KntNumer, @KntLp
While @@FETCH_STATUS=0 Begin If (@KodOrgKnt<>'') If (Exists( Select * From CDN.TwrDost Where TwD_KodOrgKnt = @KodOrgKnt and ( TwD_KntTyp = @KntTyp And TwD_KntNumer = @KntNumer) and not ( TwD_TwrTyp = @TwrTyp And TwD_TwrNumer = @TwrNumer) ) ) Begin RAISERROR('Zduplikowany kod u kontrahenta (%s) ',16,1,@KodOrgKnt) ROLLBACK TRAN End
Fetch Next From cur_InsertKod Into @KodOrgKnt, @TwrTyp, @TwrFirma, @TwrNumer, @TwrLp, @KntTyp, @KntFirma, @KntNumer, @KntLp End
Close cur_InsertKod Deallocate cur_InsertKod
End */

CREATE TRIGGER [CDN].[TwrDost_UpdateKlasaKnt] ON [CDN].[TwrDost] FOR UPDATE AS BEGIN -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from -- interfering with SELECT statements. SET NOCOUNT ON; IF UPDATE(Twd_KlasaKnt) BEGIN /* UPDATE CDN.TwrDostHist SET Tdh_KlasaKnt = I.Twd_KlasaKnt FROM INSERTED I WHERE Tdh_TwrNumer = I.Twd_TwrNumer AND Tdh_TwrLp = I.Twd_TwrLp AND Tdh_KlasaKnt = (SELECT Twd_KlasaKnt FROM DELETED)*/ --TS TID:185594 update h set h.TDH_KlasaKnt=i.TWD_KlasaKnt from CDN.TwrDostHist h join deleted d on d.TWD_TwrTyp=h.TDH_TwrTyp AND d.TWD_TwrNumer=h.TDH_TwrNumer AND d.TWD_KlasaKnt=h.TDH_KlasaKnt AND d.TWD_TwrLp=h.TDH_TwrLp join inserted i on i.TWD_TwrNumer=d.TWD_TwrNumer and i.TWD_TwrTyp=d.TWD_TwrTyp and i.TWD_TwrLp=d.TWD_TwrLp and i.TWD_KlasaKnt<>d.TWD_KlasaKnt END SET NOCOUNT OFF END
